AboutPage.headline: The first firm in Colombia specialized in corporate & government affairs
AboutPage.subhead: Temptum is an independent firm based in Bogotá. We support private-sector organizations and institutions in building defensible positions — grounded in technical analysis, regulatory knowledge, and political reading of the environment.

about.headline: A practice built on rigor, not urgency
about.body: We bring together experience in corporate communications, investigative journalism, and public affairs to serve organizations that make decisions that matter. Every engagement is staffed by teams of three to five people, with documented deliverables and a responsible partner from the first diagnosis.

aboutParagraphs: Temptum brings four lines of work — institutional relations, risk and crisis management, regulatory and legislative affairs, and ESG communications — under a single methodology: translating complex contexts into defensible decisions.

Our team combines profiles from political science, law, economics, and strategic communication, with direct experience in the public sector, the private sector, and academia. We apply risk analysis, regulatory monitoring, and stakeholder mapping methodologies to produce actionable intelligence — not generic diagnostics.

We operate under strict standards of confidentiality, independence, and compliance. We do not replace the client: we support them with technical rigor and strategic judgment so that each decision is defensible before its audiences, its regulators, and public opinion.

allies.body1: Temptum works with a stable network of sectoral, academic, and advisory partners in Colombia and the Andean region. For each project we convene the profiles the context demands: lawyers, economists, political scientists, strategic communicators, and technical specialists.
allies.body2: This network does not replace the permanent team: it complements it. Coordination, editorial judgment, and client liaison stay in-house.

commitments.headline: Three non-negotiable commitments
commitments.intro: Every engagement operates under the same three principles. They are not slogans: they are the firm's operating floor.

items.title: Strict confidentiality
items.body: Handling of sensitive information under formal protocols for access, filing, and destruction. We do not use the client's name as a marketing asset.

items.title: Independent judgment
items.body: We do not receive compensation from third parties for regulatory or public-policy outcomes. We recommend what is defensible, not what is convenient for the vendor.

items.title: Verifiable compliance
items.body: Every deliverable is traceable, every methodology documented, every working team identified in writing. Auditing our own work is part of the service.

beso-muerte-rubiales.title: The Kiss of Death: The Reputational Fall of Rubiales
beso-muerte-rubiales.resumen: A reputational autopsy of the Spanish federation president's gesture. Five factors explain why some scandals turn into a death spiral and others don't, and what crisis-management teams can learn from this case.

compliance-comunicaciones.title: Compliance and Communications: The Convergence Latin American Boards Can't Ignore
compliance-comunicaciones.resumen: How the separation between legal compliance and corporate communications is becoming operationally untenable — and why the boards of regulated companies need to rebuild the bridge between the two functions.

good-will.title: Goodwill Is Built in the Years You Don't Need It
good-will.resumen: Most institutions only remember institutional relations when they need a favor. The ones that build durable relationships in the years when no one is asking are the ones that, in a crisis, find a phone that gets answered.

ia-socio-silencioso.title: AI, the Silent Partner in Strategic Communications
ia-socio-silencioso.resumen: Generative AI is already embedded in the workflow of any communications team that processes information at scale. The question isn't whether to use it, but how to govern its use without losing the editorial judgment that's the actual differentiator.
